llm.summary: The skill is mostly a read-only reasoning guide, but its README tells users to make it an always-on identity change that affects all future agent responses.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts do not request network access, credentials, command execution, background workers, or local indexing; the main risk is broad behavioral scope rather than environmental access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is simple file copy or browser upload, with no executable installer, but README.md instructs operators to set it as always active or an identity skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime guidance in README.md says it should apply before every response and be active at all times, which conflicts with the manifest description limiting use to deep analysis or creative reasoning requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The always-active identity-skill instruction creates persistent behavior change across sessions without clear disable guidance, visible status expectations, or task-scoped opt-in.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md describes a task-scoped, read-only deep-reasoning framework that does not call tools or modify files, but README.md reframes it as a permanent identity-level cognitive operating system.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. This skill does not appear to execute code, read secrets, or modify files, but it is packaged with instructions to make it always active and identity-level. Prefer using it only per task or session, and avoid configuring it as an always-on identity skill unless you intentionally want it to influence all agent responses.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in context: README.md's permanent identity framing is not aligned with the task-scoped purpose stated in SKILL.md, even though the skill is read-only.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in context: README.md repeatedly directs always-on activation and before-every-response use, which materially expands instruction scope beyond the manifest.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted in context: the always-active or identity-skill setup is a persistent configuration change and lacks adequate user-control guidance.
